title: Internal TLS certificate expired on the service mesh

lines.author: rosa
lines.text: Pagerduty just woke me up, the mesh gateway is returning handshake failures to half the internal callers

lines.author: rosa
lines.text: just catching up on the thread

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: Confirmed. openssl says the intermediate cert on the gateway expired at 06:00 sharp

lines.author: wen
lines.text: let's keep the channel clear for updates

lines.author: rosa
lines.text: Billing and orders are both down because they call each other through the mesh

lines.author: wen
lines.text: let me grab coffee and be back in two

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: I can take the next step

lines.author: wen
lines.text: I have the renewal pipeline open, it was paused after the vault migration and nobody noticed

lines.author: wen
lines.text: Kicking off a manual renewal now

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: New cert is issued but the gateway pods have to be restarted to pick it up

lines.author: rosa
lines.text: Rolling restart of the gateway pods is going out, one zone at a time

lines.author: wen
lines.text: Orders is green again, billing still shows a few errors

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: okay, going quiet while I read

lines.author: rosa
lines.text: okay, going quiet while I read

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: Billing recovered too, error rate is back to normal

lines.author: wen
lines.text: okay, going quiet while I read

lines.author: rosa
lines.text: I will add an alert that fires two weeks before any cert expires, ticket is open

lines.author: wen
lines.text: Someone needs to unpause the renewal pipeline and add it to the weekly health check, I can do that tomorrow

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: ping me if you need a second pair of eyes

lines.author: wen
lines.text: one more thing to check first

lines.author: wen
lines.text: give me a couple of minutes

lines.author: tomas
lines.text: Overall: an unnoticed paused renewal let the gateway cert lapse and took out two core services for about an hour

correctStatements.text: At 06:10 rosa saw handshake failures from the mesh gateway.
At 06:14 tomas confirmed the intermediate certificate on the gateway expired at 06:00.
Billing and orders were down because they call each other through the mesh.
The renewal pipeline had been paused after the vault migration and nobody noticed.
At 06:31 wen started a manual certificate renewal.
At 06:42 tomas found the new certificate was issued but the gateway pods needed a restart.
At 06:48 rosa began a rolling restart of the gateway pods, one zone at a time.
At 07:02 wen saw orders recover while billing still had a few errors.
At 07:15 tomas saw billing recover and the error rate return to normal.
Rosa will add an alert that fires two weeks before any certificate expires.
Wen will unpause the renewal pipeline and add it to the weekly health check.
An unnoticed paused renewal let the gateway certificate lapse and took out two core services.
